fixed_step_table8._note: Manuscript Table 8: paired difference (KS-selected gap minus fixed-step gap), n=30 configs, recomputed from results/fixedstep.json fixed_step_summary mean_diff values.

lambda_sweep_table5._note: GNNDelete lambda sensitivity (manuscript Table 5): attack gap mean/sd at lambda in {0.25,0.5,1.0,2.0,4.0}. Only the lambda=1.0 column is recomputable from the archived per-seed JSONs (it is the Table 4 GNNDelete setting, an independent re-run that the manuscript states reproduces Table 4 within 0.001); the raw outputs of the other lambda values were not archived in the experiment tree, so the verifier checks lambda=1.0 and reports the remaining columns and the best-point utility values as NOT ARCHIVED (counted separately, not as passes). Best points: cora lambda=0.5, citeseer lambda=0.5, pubmed lambda=4.0.

provenance: Expected values are the numbers printed in the manuscript (Tables 4, 5, 8 and Section 6.2 text) and in the MEGU/ETR run records of 2026-11-04. scripts/verify_reproduction.py recomputes each aggregate from the raw per-seed JSONs under results/ and compares.
